news.title: STAT+: American Diabetes Association, facing calls for resignations, asks for patience
news.summary: An open letter to the board of the American Diabetes Association said the board had badly mishandled an incident at its annual meeting.

news.title: Visa time limits on foreign Ph.D. students and postdocs will harm U.S. science, experts warn
news.summary: A Trump administration plan to limit visas for graduate student and postdocs to four years is fueling concerns that the U.S. could lose out on foreign scientists

news.title: STAT+: Bracing for another Fauci hearing
news.summary: Plus: Democrats take on Trump over IVF, and Trump's White House releases a new science funding blueprint.

news.title: STAT+: GSK lays out plans to cut costs, pursue more late-stage drug trials
news.summary: New GSK CEO Luke Miels outlined his strategy to help the company navigate a patent cliff and get on a path toward long-term growth.

news.title: STAT+: FDA staff reiterate concerns about Replimune skin cancer treatment
news.summary: Regulators at the FDA have reiterated concerns that Replimmune does not have adequate data to support an approval of its investigational skin cancer treatment.

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about FDA views on a Duchenne drug, GSK cost savings, and more
news.summary: The FDA said a Capricor stem cell treatment for Duchenne muscular dystrophy did not meet a Phase 3 trial's objectives — contrary to company claims

news.title: STAT+: Three questions with Whoop’s new CMO

news.title: Anthony Fauci’s pandemic-era diary entries

news.title: STAT+: Preliminary trial results suggest a path to a safer Alzheimer’s treatment
news.summary: ProMIS Neurosciences is trying to design a safer amyloid-clearing drug for Alzheimer's. Early results suggest it might be on to something.

news.title: STAT+: CMS evaluates one year of health tech progress, announces eight new pledge categories
news.summary: One year after launching the CMS Health Tech Ecosystem, officials convened in D.C. to celebrate the Trump administration modernizing health technology.

news.title: STAT+: From ‘lost cause’ to gold rush: Biotechs swarm to cure AATD
news.summary: Biotech companies are racing to cure alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, AATD, fueling patent disputes, startup defections, arbitration, and a U.S.-China rivalry.

news.title: Opinion: STAT+: Dementia finally has a business model
news.summary: The big takeaway from the recent Alzheimer’s Association International Conference in London is an economic message: Dementia finally has a business model, writes Jason Karlawish.

news.title: After PCOS became PMOS, there’s hope for new awareness among Black and Latina women
news.summary: Growing awareness of a painful endocrine disorder now named PMOS is good news for women of color, who have high prevalence and low diagnosis.

news.title: STAT+: HIV resurgence is feared as global funding to combat the disease falls 18%
news.summary: The world risks a resurgence of the HIV epidemic after international financing to combat the disease suffered a “profound shock” last year, according to a new report from UNAIDS.

news.title: Universal Health Services tops Q2 expectations, but dials back full-year earnings
news.summary: Volume recovery, capacity increases, supplemental funding, some struggling facilities and a jump in liability expenses all played into a guidance revision at the acute and behavioral hospital operator. Health insurance exchange impacts, while elevated, still landed within the higher range of the company's initial expectations.

news.title: American Red Cross declares second-ever national blood supply crisis, urges ‘immediate’ donations
news.summary: Donations this summer are not “keeping pace with hospital demand,” with the nonprofit citing extreme heat, poor air quality and foodborne illnesses as factors in the low donor turnout.

news.title: Margin improvements underpin Centene's strategy for 2027 ACA plans, CEO says
news.summary: Centene reported $1.1 billion in profit for the second quarter of 2026, rebounding from a loss a year ago.

news.title: Procode AI secures $10M series A for AI-powered RCM for surgical billing
news.summary: The fresh funding will back two additional acquisitions, which executives say will be announced in the coming months.

news.title: Aurenar lands $5.7M seed funding round for non-invasive neuromodulation platform
news.summary: The funding will be used to advance the company’s technology and capabilities, CEO and founder Eric Leuthardt, M.D., told Fierce.

news.title: Included Health inks agreement to acquire Firefly Health to scale alternative health plans for employers
news.summary: Virtual care and health navigation company Included Health inked a deal to acquire Firefly Health to scale health plan alternatives for employers.

news.title: LifeBridge Health deploys Prenosis' FDA-authorized AI tool to speed sepsis detection
news.summary: LifeBridge Health's Sinai Hospital of Baltimore is putting an artificial intelligence-powered diagnostic for sepsis into clinical use, bringing a research-backed tool to the patients' bedside.

news.title: Industry survey finds MA enrollees have lower out-of-pocket costs than those in traditional Medicare
news.summary: A new analysis finds that Medicare Advantage enrollees spend less on average than those in the traditional program, but report similar satisfaction levels.

news.title: Intermountain Health acquiring interests in 2 Idaho hospitals for $795M
news.summary: The nonprofit would become the sole owner of the 88-bed Idaho Falls Community Hospital and share ownership of the 38-bed Mountain View Hospital. It has been a minority investor in both since 2023.

news.title: Salesforce lands $1.6B Veteran Affairs deal to integrate AI into healthcare workflows
news.summary: The agreement aims to create a “unified foundation across the department, equipping VA employees with trusted agentic AI, integrated data, and advanced collaboration tools that can reduce administrative friction and give staff more time to serve Veterans," the VA said.

news.title: As AI scribe adoption grows, researchers at Suki challenge the industry's quality playbook
news.summary: As adoption of AI ambient scribe technology rapidly grows, the healthcare industry's standard method for evaluating clinical AI notes may be fundamentally flawed, failing to detect significant errors in patient notes.

news.title: Flourish Health secures $26M to scale intensive youth mental healthcare
news.summary: The startup provides an in-home care model to help child and young adult patients with serious complex mental health needs.

news.title: Eli Lilly tops new biopharma ranking on launch success, development speed
news.summary: Flush with GLP-1 cash and pipeline success, Eli Lilly rose from 16th to first over five years in Norstella’s inaugural Pipeline-to-Patient Productivity Index, which evaluated 25 large, global biopharma companies on R&D productivity, market access and commercial performance.

news.title: Incyte ditches phase 1-stage JAK inhibitor to pursue next-gen options
news.summary: Incyte has ditched a JAK2 inhibitor in phase 1 development for a rare blood cancer in favor of “next-generation” replacements.

news.title: Altimmune’s next-gen GLP-1 curbs heavy drinking in ‘unequivocal’ ph. 2 alcohol use disorder win
news.summary: An experimental drug targeting both GLP-1 and glucagon receptors has curbed heavy drinking in a phase 2 trial, providing hope that the ubiquitous weight loss meds can be effectively harnessed against alcohol use disorder (AUD).

news.title: GSK unveils 3-year cost-saving plan to fund late-stage R&D, move research HQ to AZ's backyard
news.summary: GSK has unveiled an ambitious three-year plan to divert resources to its late-stage R&D programs and shift its research headquarters—but CEO Luke Miels is being tight-lipped about the extent of any job losses.

news.title: Atea’s hepatitis C asset matches Gilead’s Epclusa in phase 3 trial
news.summary: Atea Pharmaceuticals’ hepatitis C prospect has matched Gilead’s Epclusa in a phase 3 trial, keeping the biotech barreling toward a second readout for its shorter, simpler treatment regimen.

news.title: Guardant Health taps Patrick Dempsey for emotional colorectal cancer awareness video
news.summary: Colorectal cancer blood test maker Guardant Health has teamed up with “Grey’s Anatomy” star Patrick Dempsey for a new, highly emotional video.

news.title: Boston Scientific unveils major restructuring, plots job cuts amid savings drive
news.summary: Medical device maker Boston Scientific has been a prolific dealmaker this year but is now taking a step back as it looks to make changes internally.

news.title: GSK partner Hansoh reports another phase 3 win for priority ADC
news.summary: Hansoh Pharmaceutical has guided its GSK-partnered, B7-H3-directed antibody-drug conjugate to another phase 3 win in China.

news.title: ‘This could be a large market’: Novo Holdings-backed Claris secures $118M for corneal disease drug
news.summary: A new biotech has come into view with a $118 million series B and a vision for making the front of the eye front-of-mind.

news.title: Acrosian debuts as AI-focused biometrics CRO
news.summary: The founders of contract research organization Quartesian have reunited to form Acrosian, a CRO designed to be purpose-built for the AI era.

news.title: RA Capital launches rare disease company Oak Hill Bio onto Nasdaq via SPAC
news.summary: Rare disease biotech Oak Hill is headed to the Nasdaq through a SPAC merger with RA Capital-sponsored Research Alliance Corporation III (RACC) to fund a rare genetic disease candidate.

news.title: MapLight shares sink on mixed phase 2 schizophrenia readout
news.summary: MapLight Therapeutics’ stock plummeted more than 60% this morning after the neuro outfit dropped mixed results for a phase 2 trial of its experimental schizophrenia treatment.

papers.title: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: We introduce PerceptionBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the atomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing benchmarks often fail to isolate perception: holistic evaluations conflate perceptual errors with failures in reasoning or domain knowledge, while application-driven benchmarks only cover narrow, fragmented domains shaped by heuristic designs. papers.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
papers.summary: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design.
